'''Watto's Cube with fixed pack Cube''' is a sealed league format on [[GEMP]] built from Watto's Cube packs, in which each player gets the same fixed starter cards for each side plus random draft packs. GEMP's sealed league types include a league of the same name that uses this format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sealedtype" />

* '''Type:''' cube (GEMP sealed league)
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee Cube; league type from the Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' Watto's Cube packs issued by the league, 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Watto's Cube with fixed pack Cube'' (<code>wattos_cube_with_fixed</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the league type ''Watto's Cube Fixed'' is played under the [[Cube]] format<ref name="pc-slt" />

== Card pool ==
The league issues Watto's Cube packs for both sides of the Force, in two series. A player who joins gets the product of every series that has started, and every player gets each later series' product when it starts. The cards a player receives exclude duplicates across packs.<ref name="nsld" /><ref name="slp" />
* '''Series 1:''' for each side, 1 Watto's Cube Fixed Pack and 8 Watto's Cube Draft Packs.<ref name="slp" />
* '''Series 2:''' for each side, 3 Draft Packs.<ref name="slp" />
A Fixed Pack is a fixed set of 10 cards for one side; a Draft Pack holds 9 random cards from a 290-card list for that side.<ref name="wcfp" /><ref name="wcdp" />
The format sets a deck size of 40 cards, its set list is the same as [[Open]], and it is not a game hall format. Its definition links to the Players Committee Cube page.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" /> The Players Committee code plays the league under its Cube format, which sets 45 cards.<ref name="pc-slt" /><ref name="pc-gemp" />

== History ==
The Players Committee calls its cube ''Watto's Chance Cube'', or simply Cube: players draft from "packs" made by shuffling a curated set of cards instead of opening sealed product.<ref name="pc-cube" /> The ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) describes the paper version with a 450-card pool, 10 fixed cards per player and 45-card decks, in "Traditional" and "Secret Squirrel" events.<ref name="afg" /> In GEMP's league version each player receives packs of random cards from the cube list rather than drafting at a table.<ref name="wcdp" /><ref name="slp" />

The league type comes from the Players Committee GEMP code; play.swccg.com gave it its own format with the same name.<ref name="pc-slt" /><ref name="slt" /><ref name="gemp" /> No source gives who built it or when, and no league result is recorded.
